comment: Held-gun motion for the modelled Pistol on an ordinary free-for-all life (Pistol and Fists): raising it from the Fists, the shot and its slide recovery, the accepted reload through its frames, and the walk. Run tools/qa_tour.sh with FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/viewmodel-motion-pistol.json, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 and FRAGR_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1. Inspection only; not a tour publish.
